📦 Dataset Usage Notice
	

Thank you for using this dataset. It is provided and maintained by Puhuilab.

	
		
		📘 Dataset Description
	

This dataset is a compact benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the performance of recognition models on Thai language text.It is curated to support research in Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and multilingual text understanding, with an emphasis on real-world Thai script scenarios.

	
		
		📜 Terms of Use
	

By accessing or using this… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/puhuilab/th_rec_bench.
reputation: A compact, regionally useful benchmark for Thai OCR research with modest adoption in multilingual OCR and Southeast Asian language processing communities.
